$comment: The libraries a code element or a game may name. file: shipped beside code.js (products/builder/assets/lib). pro: not shipped (the vendor's licence); Auvyx Builder Pro gives its address (the vendor's CDN) through auvyx_builder_code_library_urls, and without Pro a page does not load it. export: what of the module the code gets ("*" = the module). sandbox: whether a game in Auvyx Play may use it (delivered as source text by the page; a CDN bundle that imports more files cannot be).

libraries.name: motion
libraries.about: Motion (motion.dev): animate, scroll, inView, stagger, spring, timeline

libraries.name: lenis
libraries.about: Lenis: smooth scrolling (new Lenis({ autoRaf: true }))

libraries.name: lottie
libraries.about: Lottie: After Effects animations (lottie.loadAnimation({ container, path }))

libraries.name: splitting
libraries.about: Splitting: split text into words and letters for reveals

libraries.name: gsap
libraries.about: GSAP (Auvyx Builder Pro; loaded from GSAP's own CDN, GSAP's licence): gsap.to, timelines

libraries.name: gsap-scrolltrigger
libraries.about: GSAP ScrollTrigger (Auvyx Builder Pro, with gsap): scroll scenes; register with gsap.registerPlugin
